name: JK to Ero Giin Sensei ~Kyuuka no Ojou-sama JK o Koibito ni Shite Yaritai Houdai~
original_name: JKとエロ議員センセイ～旧家のお嬢様JKを愛人にしてヤリたい放題～
source:
The protagonist is a mediocre second-rate politician from a certain ruling party.
His faction is far from the mainstream, his political base is weak, and he spends his days secretly frustrated while going through the motions of his duties. He managed to win this election, but rumors are already swirling that he might not make it next time.
He’d love to have a mistress, but he doesn’t have the means…

One day, he’s invited to a quaint inn by a local influential family to hear their request. The family head asks him to secure government funding for the region. Normally, he’d brush off such a request, but he’d heard rumors that the family had a beautiful daughter. Out of sheer curiosity, he decides to check it out.
He proposes a deal: if the family offers their daughter as his companion for the night, he’ll consider securing the funding. To his surprise, they agree.

That night, he’s introduced to Hatsune, the family’s high school-aged daughter. What was supposed to be a one-night affair turns into an unexpectedly intense experience. Afterward, the protagonist decides to take Hatsune back to Tokyo as his mistress.

But here’s the twist: Hatsune turns out to be a one-in-a-hundred-million “ultimate luck charm”!
Every time they get intimate, the protagonist’s motivation skyrockets, he wins elections, his political rivals fall from grace… Will this lead to a meteoric rise to power? Well, you’ll have to play the game to find out!

translation:
主人公是某执政党的平庸二流政治家。他所在的派系远非主流，政治基础薄弱，只能一边履行公务，一边暗自焦躁。他好不容易赢得了这次选举，却已经有传闻称他下次可能落选。
他很想找个情妇，却没有那个条件……

某天，当地名门望族邀请他到一间雅致旅馆，听取他们的请求。家主希望他为当地争取政府拨款。通常情况下，他会直接把这种要求敷衍过去，可他听说这家人有个美丽女儿，便纯粹出于好奇决定前去一探究竟。
他提出交易：如果对方愿意让女儿陪他一晚，他就会考虑争取拨款。出乎意料的是，对方答应了。

当晚，他见到了家主的高中生女儿初音。本应只持续一夜的关系，竟发展成一场出人意料的激烈体验。事后，主人公决定把初音带回东京，让她成为自己的情妇。

然而，初音其实是百亿人中才会出现一个的“终极幸运护符”！每当两人亲热，主人公的干劲就会暴涨；他能赢下选举，政治对手也会接连失势……这会将他推上飞黄腾达的权力巅峰吗？答案就等你亲自游玩后揭晓！
